en.headline: Hong Kong government condemns UK six-monthly report as interference
en.dek: The government said the report contained false and misleading remarks and urged Britain to stop interfering in Hong Kong affairs which are internal matters of China.
body: The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region government on Friday strongly condemned and firmly opposed the United Kingdom’s latest Six-Monthly Report on Hong Kong covering January to June 2026.

A government spokesman said the report contained untrue remarks and attempts to smear the city. The spokesman emphasised that the Sino-British Joint Declaration did not give Britain any right to interfere in Hong Kong’s affairs after the handover, and that Britain has no sovereignty, jurisdiction or right of supervision over Hong Kong.

The government also rejected the report’s comments on Hong Kong’s national security laws, describing them as groundless. It pointed to what it called Britain’s own double standards in applying national security legislation while criticising Hong Kong.
The spokesman urged the United Kingdom to recognise the facts, abide by international law and immediately cease interfering in matters that are purely China’s internal affairs.

zh.headline: 特區政府強烈譴責英國半年報告 斥干預香港事務
zh.dek: 政府指報告內容失實及抹黑，強調《中英聯合聲明》沒有賦予英國干預回歸後香港事務的權利，英國對香港無主權、無治權及無監督權。
body: 香港特別行政區政府周五就英國發表所謂「香港半年報告：二○二六年一月至六月」表示強烈不滿和反對，並予以強烈譴責。
政府發言人強調，報告對香港各方面情況作出失實言論和污褪抹黑。《中英聯合聲明》的核心要義是中國恢復對香港行使主權，沒有賦予英國干預回歸後香港事務的權利。英國對回歸後的香港無主權、無治權，也無監督權。
發言人亦強烈反對報告中針對香港維護國家安全法律及工作的內容，指有關說法無稽及失實，並指英國在國安法律執行上存在雙重標準。
特區政府再次強烈敦促英國認清事實，遵從國際法和國際關係基本準則，立即停止干涉純屬中國內政的香港事務。
